instructions.content: NEVER use standard Markdown links ([text](file.md)) for notes inside the vault; renames silently break them. Use [[wikilinks]] instead.
NEVER wrap external URLs in [[...]] wikilink syntax; it creates unresolvable vault references instead of hyperlinks.
NEVER place block IDs on the same line as list items or quotes; they require a separate trailing line after the block.
NEVER embed full notes with ![[Note]] when only a section is relevant; use ![[Note#Heading]].
NEVER include spaces in tag names; a space terminates the tag and the rest becomes unindexed plain text.
NEVER place YAML frontmatter anywhere except the very first line of the file.
Use [[wikilinks]] for notes within the vault and [text](url) for external URLs only.
Add frontmatter with properties (title, tags, aliases) at the top of the file as the first step of creating a note.
Write callouts with > [!type], an optional custom title on the opening line, and - or + after the type for collapsed or expanded.
Define a block ID by appending ^block-id and link to it with [[Note#^block-id]].
Highlight text with ==highlighted text==.
Tags may contain letters, numbers (not as the first character), underscores, hyphens and forward slashes; #nested/tag gives hierarchy.
Embed an image at a given width with ![[image.png|300]].
Embed a PDF page with ![[document.pdf#page=3]].
Hide text with %%comment%% inline or in a %% block %% that is hidden in reading view.
Write maths as LaTeX: inline with $...$ and block with $$...$$.
Draw diagrams in a mermaid fenced block, and link a node to a note by adding class NodeName internal-link;.
Write footnotes as text[^1] with a [^1]: definition, or inline as ^[text].
Verify the note renders correctly in Obsidian's reading view.
Do not apply Obsidian syntax to plain Markdown outside a vault, such as GitHub READMEs, where it renders as raw text.
